unclear_handling: Always report unclear frequency separately; do not count it as false or as a hallucination. Also report supported/all-scored-items as a transparent descriptive lower fraction with its denominator.
threshold_role: fixed descriptive diagnostic, never tuned on human labels; NLI probabilities are not assumed calibrated
pooling: Analyze the two sampling strata separately. The initial set sampled sentences across outputs; the KV set samples one sentence per summary within 20 fixed documents x 4 conditions x 2 deltas. Do not pool these into a population hallucination estimate.
cache_contrast: Within each delta, calculate supported indicator changes on matched documents for cross-full, self-full, both-full and cross-self only for pairs without unclear. Report n eligible document pairs and incompleteness; pointwise exploratory intervals, no confirmatory significance claim.
incomplete_labels: Validate and report progress. Do not issue scientific audit results unless all 260 items have a completed human label and required evidence/reason, except with a separately declared partial-audit analysis.
disagreements: Retain original independent annotator files. Resolve only after independent labels are locked. No automatic model arbitration presented as human consensus.
limits: The annotator has already seen study-level findings; group labels and model scores are hidden at item level.
Twenty KV documents cannot support precise population hallucination-rate estimates.
No labels generated by AI are counted as human annotations.
